subject: Temporary credit request for multitenancy rollout delay
messages:
From: Tim Keller <tim.keller@acme.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: sally.cho@acme.com
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Production delay — request for one-time credit

Ben,

Thanks for the quick onboarding last month. We were aiming to cut over to Redwoods' multitenancy controls before our holiday rollout, but engineering just alerted us that the feature flag gating and tenant isolation docs will slip ~6 weeks. That impacts our ability to go live with 3 internal products.

Because this is a timing issue tied to your roadmap, Procurement is asking whether Redwood can provide a one-time billing credit to offset the implementation delay (we estimate ~$35k of additional infra and QA costs). Can you let me know if that's possible and what approval path you'd need?

We'd like to avoid pausing the pilot — happy to accept a conditional credit linked to a firm delivery milestone.

Thanks,
Tim Keller
Sr. Program Manager — Platform Launches
Acme Corp

Attachment: Acme_Rollout_impact.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai

Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Production delay — request for one-time credit

Tim — thanks for the heads up and the impact spreadsheet. I'm really sorry about the slip; I know how disruptive timing changes are for launch schedules.

Next steps from our side:
- I'll loop in Product and Finance to scope a possible one-time credit and approval path.
- Internal ask: can Product confirm a firm ETA and an acceptance test we can promise Acme?
- I'll propose a conditional credit tied to that ETA (something like a percentage rebate if feature misses the milestone).

Laura / Sergio — can you weigh in on what we can commit to here and what Finance will need to greenlight a credit?

Ben Carter

- Is this the multitenancy isolation work in the 2026.4 milestone (tenant routing + KMS scoping)?
- Can Engineering provide a validated delivery date and acceptance criteria (smoke tests + tenant isolation cert)?

Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Production delay — request for one-time credit / ETA from Eng

Ben / Sergio — I spoke with Eng yesterday. Summary:
- The multitenancy control plane pieces (tenant routing + namespace isolation) are mostly done; the delay is in docs, automated acceptance tests, and a final KMS integration edge-case.
- Firm ETA we can give: target release window is 2026-12-22 to 2026-12-29. We can commit to an internal acceptance test by 2026-12-20.

Suggested commercial approach (to get Procurement comfortable):
1) Offer a one-time credit equal to 15% of the monthly committed invoice for Dec 2026 (applied as a credit on Jan invoice), OR a fixed credit up to $30k — whichever is lower.
2) Credit is conditional: only applied if we miss the 2026-12-20 acceptance test milestone. If we meet the milestone, no credit issued.
3) Require SOW amendment + Exec signoff (Finance approval) before we present to Acme.

Marissa — can you confirm Finance OK with conditional 15% cap or suggest an alternate approval threshold?

Laura Bennett
Director, Product Operations | Redwood Inference

Attachment: mt-release-plan-2026-12.pdf (attachment stub)

Team — Finance reviewed the case and will approve a conditional, one-time credit with these constraints:
- Credit: up to 15% of a single monthly committed invoice for Dec 2026, capped at $30,000.
- Condition: Customer must sign an SOW amendment that documents the delivery milestone (internal acceptance test on 2026-12-20) and the credit clause.
- Approval requires VP Sales (my sign-off) + Legal to finalize amendment language.

Please prepare the SOW amendment (Legal and Sales Ops will help); once signed, we'll queue the credit to be applied automatically if the milestone is missed.

Approved by: Marissa Cole, VP Finance (email sign-off)
